map.FLOPs 和显存是一回事吗？: Are FLOPs and VRAM the same thing?
map.不是。FLOPs 衡量算力(时间)，显存衡量参数与激活的存储(空间)。量化降显存: No. FLOPs measures compute (time), while VRAM measures the storage of parameters and activations (space). Quantisation cuts VRAM without cutting FLOPs; sparsity and distillation can reduce both.
map.与 FFN 相比，注意力在长序列时 dominated by S²，是推理成本优: Compared with the FFN, attention on long sequences is dominated by S^2, which makes it the main target for inference cost optimisation.
map.为什么长文本推理特别慢？: Why is inference on long text so slow?
map.单头注意力 FLOPs≈2·S²·d（QKᵀ 与 AV 两次矩阵乘），S 为序列: Single-head attention FLOPs ~= 2 * S^2 * d (two matrix products, QK^T and AV), where S is the sequence length and d the dimension.
map.单层 FLOPs ≈ 2S²d (QKᵀ) + 2S²d (AV) = 4S²d: Per-layer FLOPs ~= 2S^2d (QK^T) + 2S^2d (AV) = 4S^2d; whole-model GFLOPs = per-layer x number of layers / 10^9
map.多头总计算≈2·S²·h·d_head + 4·S·d²（含 Q/K/V/O 投: Total multi-head compute ~= 2 * S^2 * h * d_head + 4 * S * d^2 (including the Q/K/V/O projections); the S^2 term makes the compute grow quadratically with sequence length.
map.按序列长度、头数与隐藏维度估算单层及全模型注意力的浮点运算量 FLOPs，适用于: Estimates the floating-point operation count (FLOPs) of attention per layer and for the whole model from sequence length, head count and hidden dimension. Suitable for LLM compute evaluation, inference cost modelling and hardware selection.
map.注意力核心项是 S²·d，序列翻倍算力翻约 4 倍；KV 缓存虽降重算，但注意力: The core term of attention is S^2 * d, so doubling the sequence length multiplies compute by about 4. KV caching avoids repeated computation, but the attention matrix still grows with the square of context length, so long-context cost climbs steeply.
map.自注意力的两次矩阵乘各为 S×S×d 规模，乘加各算一次故乘 2，合计 4S²d: The two matrix products in self-attention are each of size S x S x d, and counting each multiply and add gives a factor of 2, so 4S^2 d in total, growing with the square of the sequence length - which is exactly why long-context cost explodes. Linear attention and sparse attention exist precisely to break that S^2 term.
map.：S=1024, h=16, d_head=64(总 d=1024)：S² 项≈: : S=1024, h=16, d_head=64 (total d=1024): the S^2 term is about 2 x 1024^2 x 1024 ~= 2.15 x 10^9 FLOPs; the projections 4 * S * d^2 = 4 x 1024 x 1024^2 ~= 4.29 x 10^9. One layer is about 6.4 x 10^9 FLOPs, and 12 layers about 7.7 x 10^10.
